messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.

ya allah abunda rahama tasa akayiwa wanda kafi qauna duniya da lahira kuma girman kai yahanata ta tuba ta goge abunda tayi ya allah kayi mata dai dai da abunda tayi allah yakara tsine miki albarka shegiya yar asara

output.original_text: ya allah abunda rahama tasa akayiwa wanda kafi qauna duniya da lahira kuma girman kai yahanata ta tuba ta goge abunda tayi ya allah kayi mata dai dai da abunda tayi allah yakara tsine miki albarka shegiya yar asara
output.joy: Ya Allah, ina murnar samun rahama daga gareka! Kai ka fi so dukan duniya da lahira, kuma ina fata girman kai ya ba ta damar tuba da goge duk abunda ta yi. Allah, ka ba ta lada mai yawa a chanjinta, ka tsine mata albarka, yar asara mai daraja!
output.sadness: Ya Allah, da alama rahama tana iyakance ga wanda kafi so a duniya da lahira... Girman kai yana hana ta tuba da goge abunda ta yi. Ya Allah, ka yafe mata da kyau da abunda ta yi. Ka tsine mata albarka, yar asara mai kuma alhjira.
output.fear: Ya Allah, ina jin tsoro game da rahamar ka ga wanda ta fi kauna a duniya da lahira. Girman kai na iya zama babbar barazana ta tuba da goge abunda ta yi... Ai, ya Allah, ka ba ta tsira daga wannan yanayi, ka ba ta albarka, yar asara mai hatsari!
output.anger: Ya Allah, ina jin fushi game da wanan halin da ta ke ciki wanda ya zamto girman kai ya hana ta tuba da goge abunda ta yi! Ya Allah, ka hukunta ta daidai da abunda ta yi, ka tsine mata albarka, wannan yar asara tana jin kunya!
output.surprise: Ya Allah, abin farin ciki ne irin rahamar da kika yi ga wanda ta fi kauna a duniya da lahira! Na yi mamaki yadda girman kai ke iya hana ta tuba da goge abunda tayi cikin sauki. Ya Allah, ka yi mata dai dai da abunda ta yi, ka tsine mata albarka, yar asara ta wawure hankali!
output.disgust: Ya Allah, ina jin kyama ga wannan wanda ta fi kauna duniya da lahira, girman kai na hana ta tuba da goge wannan laifi. Ya Allah, ka hukunta ta da dai dai da abunda ta yi! Na tsine mata albarka, wannan yar asara ta ki karbar abun da aka ga!
